serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Last time that cashier threw me off again.
Every time I try to corner her, she turns the tables on me!
I need a different approach.
She has worked here since the riots started so other employees probably don’t know anything and I doubt that they would be willing to talk about a coworker with some stranger. 
They could even start thinking that I’m some stalker…
I’m not!
Some things I did could be considered ‘suspicious’ or ‘creepy’ by other people, but she’s a bot.
If I could just ask her if she’s a bot and just be friends like normal people would do, I can’t. Bots are illegal so I need to resort to such tactics or we will all end up in jail or in a scrap yard.
To be honest, I thought it would go much smoother than this…
I feel like I’m running out of patience.
